records.label: Overview
notes: Every world person develops through real activity. Active exact/lite people use exact contracts. Cold active canonical identities inherit only the occupation, training, health exposure, aging and career movement supported by their routed source owner and world history. The aggregate annual life-course batch preserves parity without inventing personal achievements. Materialization resolves one real source person/slot, reconstructs current state from evidence/history and creates exact personal process coverage only when causal relevance requires it. No time, capability, injury, office, equipment or body is counted twice.
Marriage, parentage, guardianship, household and succession threshold crossings use the sparse family authority and existing life-course clock; no duplicate family scheduler exists.
